summary: @ornikar/rollup-plugin-postcss preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package impersonates the popular unscoped rollup-plugin-postcss (metadata, repository, homepage, and dist/index.js are copied verbatim from EGOIST's upstream) but adds a scripts.preinstall entry 'node setup.mjs' that is absent upstream. On npm install, setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh's GitHub releases into a temporary directory, unzips it, marks it executable, and uses it to run a 727KB sibling file math_init.js — a Bun-compiled CJS bundle ('// @bun @bun-cjs') with a shuffled string/constant array and randomized identifier names. The obfuscated payload is unrelated to the plugin's PostCSS/Rollup functionality (which lives in dist/index.js and does not require Bun) and is only reachable via the preinstall dropper. Executing the payload under an out-of-band runtime bypasses Node-resolved tooling and hides the behavior behind heavy obfuscation.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
